description: This file is a shell script for setting up and testing Git hooks related to 'proc-receive' in a Git repository environment. It includes functions for setting up upstream repositories, executing tests over different protocols (local and HTTP), and handling various test configurations and preliminary setup steps.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Sets up a bare upstream Git repository and a workbench repository, creates commits and tags, and sets up pre-receive and post-receive hooks.

methods.name: run_proc_receive_hook_test
methods.description: Runs tests for the proc-receive hook using either local or HTTP protocols.
